notes.title: Pixel FX Designer v1.1.6.0 update is here!
notes.notes:
[h1]Pixel Fx Designer v1.1.6.0 Changelog[/h1]

[h1]NEW FEATURES[/h1]
[list]
[*] Particle Repel engine: New function in Particles>Motion that allow particles to push each other.
[*] Random Seed selection: You can now set the random seed for seamless looping so if you find a seed that you like, it doesn't get randomized again.
[*] 11 new examples to showcase the new features.
[/list]

[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]
[list]
[*] Alpha now works properly. Yes it does, It's finally here.
[*] Render Desync when rendering while running the app below 60fps is now fixed, no more broken loops.
[*] Input windows will no longer start out of focus.
[*] Several minor bugfixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Pixel FX Designer v1.1.5.3 Hotfix
notes.notes:
[h1]​Pixel Fx Designer v1.1.5.3 Changelog[/h1]
[b]CHANGES[b]
[list]
[*] You can now press <H> to show/hide tooltips.
[*] Export .GIF function now properly works when the app is in a folder with spaces in the address.
[*] Fixed several bugs that caused old examples to crash.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the visuals tab to crash.
[*] Fixed a visual bug caused by changing canvas resolution.
[/list]
